name: Images Import
description: Import single or multiple images via CSV.
project_description:
The Images Import module provides an interface for importing images on entities in Drupal. It allows us to replace or update images attached to content types, users or other entities. Upload a CSV file with the entity_title and image_url columns. Optionally, include an entity_id column to import images based on the entity ID instead of the title.

 The module also introduces a streamlined process: images can be uploaded directly without needing to place them in a server folder beforehand. The module takes care of the entire upload and association process, saving time and making imports faster and more efficient.

 Features 
 - Supports both image and media field types.

- Allows import of single or multiple images based on entity title or entity ID.

- Enables removal of existing images from entities.
